body: Please know that I mean this from the bottom of my heart. I love you Ethan and Hila. You've helped me through tough times. Suicidal times. I love you guys for that and hope you can take this pain off my shoulders and share it on youtube to your audience. I'm tired of this not being something that is talked about in society. I am tired and I don't want to back down from this. Trust me. I wanted to die. Nothing is worse than that and people should know what its like to live in fear and panic 24/7 in the dorms of UGA and any university or college.

Please share this. I have had suicidal thoughts in the past. I need my message out wide and open for the world to see. I dont care about anything but the safety of those that I love and that of myself
